notes: Godot 4.6/4.7 Wild Jam #92 (theme brewing) roguelike The Coffeehouse Always Wins v1.02: main menu-to-shop loop, random beans/ingredients, barista, map, and save data. Code is GPL-3.0; the authors license their own assets under CC BY-SA 4.0 (README). All rasters are tiny 1-bit pixel art drawn in GIMP (barista, items, tiles, bitmap font sheet, cup icon); music and SFX were made in Furnace. No TTF/OTF fonts, no addons, no Git LFS, no editor .tmp. icon.png is the upstream 1-bit coffee-cup mark (md5 7cbbd31f349ef7961860faac77112d97), not the Godot default icon.
